2609.05284.title: GUT: Quantifying and Optimizing the Reasoning Uncertainty of LLMs via Graph Complexity
2609.05284.paper_summary: Recent years have witnessed great advances in the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the reasoning processes of LLMs often exhibit uncertainty, where LLMs often produce a proliferation of divergent branches at each reasoning step even when fed the same prompting inputs, and certain branches exhibit evidently incredible, even nonsensical, reasoning chains and results. In this paper, we propose the Graph-complexity-based UncerTainty (GUT) method for investigating the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs. The key idea of GUT is to characterize the potential branches of each reasoning chain with a directed acyclic graph, thereby ensuring that all potential branches are comprehensively covered within the graph space. Building upon this recognition, we further build two modules of GUT, that is, a Quantification (GUT-Q) module and an Optimization (GUT-O) module, for quantifying and reducing the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs, respectively. GUT-Q measures LLM reasoning uncertainty by approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity. GUT-O implements uncertainty optimization by treating negative uncertainty as the reward function in reinforcement learning. Experimental results conducted on four LLMs and five datasets validate the effectiveness of GUT.
2609.05284.paper_summary_zh: 近年來，大型語言模型（LLMs）的推理能力取得了重大進展。<lb/>然而，LLMs的推理過程常常顯示出不確定性，即使在相同的提示輸入下，LLMs在每個推理步驟中也經常產生大量不同的分支，而某些分支則顯示出明顯不合理甚至荒謬的推理鏈和結果。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了基於圖複雜度的不確定性（GUT）方法，以研究LLMs的推理不確定性。<lb/>GUT的關鍵思想是用有向無環圖來描述每個推理鏈的潛在分支，從而確保所有潛在分支在圖空間內得到全面覆蓋。<lb/>基於這一認識，我們進一步建立了GUT的兩個模塊，即量化（GUT-Q）模塊和優化（GUT-O）模塊，分別用於量化和減少LLMs的推理不確定性。<lb/>GUT-Q通過用圖複雜度來近似推理空間的複雜度來測量LLM的推理不確定性。<lb/>GUT-O通過將負不確定性視為強化學習中的獎勵函數來實現不確定性優化。<lb/>在四個LLMs和五個數據集上進行的實驗結果驗證了GUT的有效性。
